Exact Answer: 26

Based on historical records of La Liga, FC Barcelona won the league titles in the 1947–48 and 1948–49 seasons. During these specific seasons, the league consisted of **14 teams**. In a double round-robin format (where each team plays every other team twice, once at home and once away), the number of games played by each team is calculated as $2 \times (14 - 1) = 26$.

Exact Answer: 26
